explanation_full: The incremental feature analysis shows a clear trend: as more features are included in the model, both R² and MSE improve.  KNN consistently outperforms other models across all feature subsets. With 11 features, KNN achieves an R² of 0.817 and an MSE of 0.0128, indicating strong predictive power. This suggests that a combination of VFA, Butyrate, Acetate, VSS, Propionate, Ethanol, COD-O, pH, ORP_Low, ORP_Mid, and Sucrose_Degradation effectively captures the key factors influencing hydrogen production.
